✅ Correct Answer: C — Fifth gear

📖 Explanation:

At Catalunya in 1994, Michael Schumacher's Benetton B194 suffered a hydraulic failure on lap 21, locking his gearbox permanently in fifth gear.

Despite this massive handicap, Schumacher adapted his driving lines to maintain corner speeds and even successfully executed a pit stop, launching from a standstill in fifth gear.

He finished the 65-lap race in second place behind Damon Hill, producing one of the most legendary drives in Formula 1 history.
